outcome: Composite maternal adverse outcome (admission to ICU, maternal blood transfusion, uterine rupture, unplanned hysterectomy)
cohort: 1,440,510 women in the US with live births from 2014 to 2018, delivering non-anomalous singletons at 24-36 weeks of gestation
finding: Preterm birth with cesarean delivery, particularly without labor, was associated with a higher risk of composite maternal morbidity compared to vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery without labor had a higher rate of composite maternal morbidity than cesarean during labor or vaginal delivery in the context of preterm birth.
